about: Hosts a page should not load scripts from, because the named source reports they served injected or malicious code. Read by script-known-bad-host. A host matches itself and every subdomain. Each entry names its source. "proposed" means the entry was written from a recollection of the source, not from a copy of it opened by a maintainer, so confirm it before relying on it. Every entry is proposed until one has been confirmed.

hosts.note: Sold in February 2024; in June 2024 researchers reported its scripts sending some visitors to unrelated sites.
